# Kovil AI

> Kovil AI is a managed AI engineering firm that embeds vetted Tier-1 AI engineers into enterprise teams. It offers fixed-price AI project delivery, scalable AI team augmentation, and AI app rescue — all milestone-gated with zero delivery risk. Engineers are matched within 24–48 hours and typically ship a first feature within 14 days.

Kovil AI builds and deploys AI agents, LLM-powered chatbots, RAG pipelines, workflow automations, and custom AI integrations for enterprises across fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, logistics, and more.

## Engagement Models
- Managed AI Engineer: embed a vetted AI engineer into an existing team, scale up or down as needed
- Outcome-Based AI Projects: fixed-scope, fixed-timeline AI product builds from scratch
- AI Reliability & App Rescue: audit, fix, and maintain failing AI agents, hallucinating RAG pipelines, or unfinished AI-built apps

## Hire by Role
- [All Hire Pages](https://kovil.ai/hire): Hub for hiring AI, ML, and automation specialists (AI agent developers, LLM engineers, prompt engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, and more)

- [Agentforce](https://kovil.ai/agentforce): Salesforce Agentforce deployment services
